field.name: allowed_coefficient_table_ids
field.help: Coefficient tables used for this customer's rental pricing. When a product also has tables configured, the intersection determines which table applies. Leave empty to use the standard default.

field.name: use_dynamic_pricing
field.help: When enabled, seasonal/time-based dynamic pricing factors are applied to this customer's rental prices. Disable to always use factor 100% (no adjustment).
